text:
maria_cs: Harbor Labs pilot sent a consolidated feedback list after week 2 of onboarding. They want product to triage so CS can update the renewal playbook.

maria_cs: Their short asks from the export: 
```
A) route-level billing breakdown (finance needs allocation per campaign)
B) org-scoped embeddings export (data team automation)
C) offline agent sync for air-gapped sites (legal req)
D) admin RBAC in Console (different teams, limited perms)
E) SSO + automatic team provisioning (Okta SCIM)
```

devin_pm: Which ones are showstoppers for their production pilot / renewal?

maria_cs: A and C are blockers; D and E are medium; B is nice-to-have but they flagged it for analyst productivity. Renewal is in ~5 weeks, they're vocal about billing visibility. :pager:

alina_prod: Customer impact short bullets: A -> revenue recognition & monthly invoicing mismatch, legal review blocking payments. C -> security sign-off fail for air-gapped sites. D/E -> onboarding overhead (10+ seats) and manual provisioning. B -> saves ~12 analyst hours / month.

noah_eng: High-level effort estimates (very rough): A (route billing) -> 2 engs + 1 infra ~5-7 weeks (usage pipeline + billing model changes). C (offline sync) -> 3 engs infra + packaging ~8-10 weeks including on-prem installer. B (embeddings export) -> 1 eng ~2 weeks. D (RBAC) -> 1 eng + 1 designer ~3-4 weeks. E (SSO SCIM) -> 1 eng ~2-3 weeks (depends on library).

devin_pm: Given that, priority from product POV: A > C > D/E > B. But CS urgency pushes A very high. Any quick mitigations we can offer so they don't pause the pilot?

maria_cs: We offered a temporary daily CSV split export for billing (manual handoff) and a staged security attestation for the air-gapped sites (limited PoC run). Customer said CSV is usable for up to 6 weeks if we commit to roadmap.

ops-bot: Created ticket RD-4412: "Harbor pilot - route billing interim export + RFC" assigned to @noah_eng.

noah_eng: I'll spike an API-first approach for A to avoid console work and try to shave 2 weeks off. Will add acceptance criteria in RD-4412.

devin_pm: Please add impact/effort scores on the roadmap: A Impact=9 Effort=8, C Impact=8 Effort=9, D Impact=6 Effort=3, E Impact=6 Effort=2, B Impact=5 Effort=2.

alina_prod: Can CS ask Harbor to rank their internal priority 1-5 and confirm which mitigations they'll accept? That will help us sequence engineering work.

maria_cs: On it. Pinged their procurement and infra leads, asked for one-line ranking and acceptance of CSV interim. I'll paste when they reply.

noah_eng: FYI if Harbor confirms we can start A as API-only + export hook, we can parallelize the heavy infra work for C later.

devin_pm: Good. Action items: maria -> confirm customer ranking & CSV acceptance; noah -> add API spike in RD-4412; devin -> update roadmap board and schedule a 30m grooming.

maria_cs: Harbor replied: ranking = A, C, E, D, B. They accept the CSV interim if we deliver a commit date within 3 weeks. Renewal risk = "elevated" if A not committed.

devin_pm: Thanks. We'll treat A as immediate priority. Closing thread; will follow up in RD-4412 and roadmap board. :white_check_mark:
